_doc: Reputation quartermasters' gear (tools/build_faction_rewards.py). Sold as unique:<id>.

cc_archivists_cowl.name: Archivist's Cowl
cc_archivists_cowl.flavor_text: A deep red cowl with a reading lens sewn into the brim.

cc_codex_bound_gloves.name: Codex-Bound Gloves
cc_codex_bound_gloves.flavor_text: Ink-stained to the knuckle. The Codex counts that as a qualification.

cc_marginalia_of_the_deep.name: Marginalia of the Deep
cc_marginalia_of_the_deep.flavor_text: Notes in the margins of a book nobody has finished. Some of them are answers.

cc_bastion_warden_girdle.name: Bastion Warden's Girdle
cc_bastion_warden_girdle.flavor_text: Worn by the blood elves who hold the Bastion's stair against whatever climbs it.

cc_lamplighter_boots.name: Lamplighter's Boots
cc_lamplighter_boots.flavor_text: Soft-soled, for the ones who carry the lamps out past where the light reaches.

cc_signet_of_the_find.name: Signet of the Find
cc_signet_of_the_find.flavor_text: A find, not a discovery. A find was already there.

og_grunts_warhelm.name: Grunt's Warhelm
og_grunts_warhelm.flavor_text: Red iron with a nose guard. Every grunt's first helm looks like it, and the good ones keep it.

og_korkron_shoulderguards.name: Kor'kron Shoulderguards
og_korkron_shoulderguards.flavor_text: Spiked pauldrons in the Warchief's colours, made for standing in a doorway.

og_farseers_mail_vest.name: Farseer's Mail Vest
og_farseers_mail_vest.flavor_text: Hung with wolf-tooth charms that rattle before the lightning comes.

og_wolfrider_leggings.name: Wolfrider's Leggings
og_wolfrider_leggings.flavor_text: Worn smooth on the inside of the knee by years in a wolf's saddle.

og_spiritwalker_bracers.name: Spiritwalker's Bracers
og_spiritwalker_bracers.flavor_text: Bound with blue cord, the way the old shaman bound them.

og_band_of_the_red_stone.name: Band of the Red Stone
og_band_of_the_red_stone.flavor_text: Cut from the same red rock as the city's walls.

ds_headhunters_mask.name: Headhunter's Mask
ds_headhunters_mask.flavor_text: A carved wooden mask with tusks. The eye holes are smaller than you'd expect.

ds_hexers_robe.name: Hexer's Robe
ds_hexers_robe.flavor_text: Stitched with little bone charms. The Darkspear's hexers wear it to remind Zalazane who's still here.

ds_bonecharm_necklace.name: Bonecharm Necklace
ds_bonecharm_necklace.flavor_text: Fish bones and a carved shell on a cord. A witch doctor blessed every one.

ds_tidewalker_waders.name: Tidewalker Waders
ds_tidewalker_waders.flavor_text: For wading out to the isles at low tide, where the drowned ones wait.

ds_shadow_hunters_bracers.name: Shadow Hunter's Bracers
ds_shadow_hunters_bracers.flavor_text: Painted with the marks of a shadow hunter who never gave his name.

ds_spearguard_girdle.name: Spearguard Girdle
ds_spearguard_girdle.flavor_text: A troll warrior's belt, notched where the spear rests.

fs_apothecarys_gloves.name: Apothecary's Gloves
fs_apothecarys_gloves.flavor_text: Waxed gloves from the Apothecarium. The stains won't come out, and nobody asks what they are.

fs_deathstalkers_hood.name: Deathstalker's Hood
fs_deathstalkers_hood.flavor_text: Grey and close-fitting. Deathstalkers don't want to be remembered by their faces.

fs_dark_ranger_spaulders.name: Dark Ranger's Spaulders
fs_dark_ranger_spaulders.flavor_text: Black mail edged in silver, after the Banshee Queen's own rangers.

fs_deathguard_legplates.name: Deathguard Legplates
fs_deathguard_legplates.flavor_text: The Deathguard hold Brill's road. These hold the Deathguard up.

fs_grave_cold_band.name: Grave-Cold Band
fs_grave_cold_band.flavor_text: Cold to the touch, and it never warms however long you wear it.

fs_shroud_of_the_wakened.name: Shroud of the Wakened
fs_shroud_of_the_wakened.flavor_text: Cut from a burial shroud by someone who woke up in it.

sc_bruisers_gauntlets.name: Cartel Bruiser's Gauntlets
sc_bruisers_gauntlets.flavor_text: Brass knuckles built into the plate. The Cartel's neutrality is enforced.

sc_contractors_belt.name: Contractor's Belt
sc_contractors_belt.flavor_text: Six pockets, and every one has a receipt in it.

sc_wharf_inspectors_coat.name: Wharf Inspector's Coat
sc_wharf_inspectors_coat.flavor_text: Chain under a goblin's long coat. Inspections in Ratchet are occasionally contested.

sc_neutral_ground_mantle.name: Neutral Ground Mantle
sc_neutral_ground_mantle.flavor_text: Horde red on one shoulder, Alliance blue on the other. Diplomacy, the goblin way.

sc_tidepaid_ring.name: Tidepaid Ring
sc_tidepaid_ring.flavor_text: Paid out by the tide's ledger. The Cartel insures its healers.

sc_harbourmasters_slippers.name: Harbourmaster's Slippers
sc_harbourmasters_slippers.flavor_text: Soft enough to walk the quay at night without waking the dockhands.

tb_spireborn_headdress.name: Spireborn Headdress
tb_spireborn_headdress.flavor_text: Feathers from the eagles that nested on the spires. There aren't any more of them.

tb_plainsrunner_leggings.name: Plainsrunner's Leggings
tb_plainsrunner_leggings.flavor_text: For running the Barrens. Nobody runs Mulgore any more.

tb_taurajo_bulwark_girdle.name: Taurajo Bulwark Girdle
tb_taurajo_bulwark_girdle.flavor_text: Heavy enough to anchor a tauren against a charging kodo, which is the test.

tb_windhoof_bracers.name: Windhoof Bracers
tb_windhoof_bracers.flavor_text: Kodo hide, bound with sinew. A druid's in cat form never notices them.

tb_earthmothers_mantle.name: Earthmother's Mantle
tb_earthmothers_mantle.flavor_text: Carved stone beads on the shoulders, one for every spire.

tb_totem_of_the_lost_spires.name: Totem of the Lost Spires
tb_totem_of_the_lost_spires.flavor_text: Four little spires carved on a single stick. The shaman who sells it won't talk about the fourth.

bb_harbour_guard_helm.name: Harbour Guard's Helm
bb_harbour_guard_helm.flavor_text: Dented by cannonballs, polished for the Baron.

bb_corsair_hunter_vest.name: Corsair-Hunter's Vest
bb_corsair_hunter_vest.flavor_text: Light enough to swim in, which matters more on Booty Bay's payroll than it should.

bb_navigators_belt.name: Navigator's Belt
bb_navigators_belt.flavor_text: A sextant pouch on one hip and a lightning charm on the other.

bb_barons_waistcoat.name: Baron's Silk Waistcoat
bb_barons_waistcoat.flavor_text: Cut for the Baron's fitting and sold when he grew out of it.

bb_tide_readers_gloves.name: Tide-Reader's Gloves
bb_tide_readers_gloves.flavor_text: Cold, and they always feel wet, and the tide tables are stitched on the palms.

bb_cannoneers_ring.name: Cannoneer's Ring
bb_cannoneers_ring.flavor_text: A brass ring blackened by powder. It's been close to a lot of loud things.

ac_forgeguard_breastplate.name: Ashhold Forgeguard Breastplate
ac_forgeguard_breastplate.flavor_text: Dark iron, hammered on the deed-holder's own anvil.

ac_riggers_gloves.name: Cinderwharf Rigger's Gloves
ac_riggers_gloves.flavor_text: Tarred palms for climbing rigging in the wind off the volcano.

ac_scoria_pauldrons.name: Scoria-Plated Pauldrons
ac_scoria_pauldrons.flavor_text: Plates of cooled volcanic glass on a mail frame. Light, sharp and hot to the touch.

ac_pyremongers_hood.name: Pyremonger's Hood
ac_pyremongers_hood.flavor_text: A Dark Iron fire-priest's hood, singed around the eye slits.

ac_deed_holders_signet.name: Deed-Holder's Signet
ac_deed_holders_signet.flavor_text: A copy of the Ashhold seal. The original is in a vault the goblins insured.

ac_ashpriests_bindings.name: Ashpriest's Bindings
ac_ashpriests_bindings.flavor_text: Wraps a Dark Iron healer wears so the forge-burns on her wrists don't show.

er_sentinel_glaivebelt.name: Sentinel's Glaivebelt
er_sentinel_glaivebelt.flavor_text: A hook at the hip for a glaive, worn by the Sentinels on the Fel Line.

er_timbermaw_hide_leggings.name: Timbermaw Hide Leggings
er_timbermaw_hide_leggings.flavor_text: Furbolg-tanned and heavy. The Timbermaw make them for the ones who stand in front.

er_grovewardens_robe.name: Grovewarden's Robe
er_grovewardens_robe.flavor_text: Green as the cleansed glade, and it smells of moonflowers.

er_reclaimers_hauberk.name: Reclaimer's Hauberk
er_reclaimers_hauberk.flavor_text: A Sentinel ranger's hauberk, cut down for a transplant who earned it.

er_treant_bark_wristguards.name: Treant-Bark Wristguards
er_treant_bark_wristguards.flavor_text: Shed bark from an old treant, bound over steel. He said he didn't need it.

er_moonwell_pendant.name: Moonwell Pendant
er_moonwell_pendant.flavor_text: A drop of the Sanctuary's moonwell, sealed in glass. It glows faintly at night.

cc_staff_of_the_hanging_light.name: Staff of the Hanging Light
cc_staff_of_the_hanging_light.flavor_text: Its head is a sliver of whatever hangs at the centre of the Underdark. Nobody's climbed up to check.

cc_crimson_spellblade.name: Crimson Spellblade
cc_crimson_spellblade.flavor_text: A Sunstrider spellblade, red to the hilt. It cuts spells as well as it cuts anything else.

cc_cloak_of_the_long_descent.name: Cloak of the Long Descent
cc_cloak_of_the_long_descent.flavor_text: Lined with the dark of the fissure. It's still warm from the lamps that went down with it.

og_warchiefs_due.name: Warchief's Due
og_warchiefs_due.flavor_text: Paid to the Warchief by every Horde forge, and handed on to whoever earned it.

og_bulwark_of_the_valley.name: Bulwark of the Valley
og_bulwark_of_the_valley.flavor_text: Painted with the Valley of Trials, where every orc first learned to stand.

og_farseers_ancestral_mace.name: Farseer's Ancestral Mace
og_farseers_ancestral_mace.flavor_text: Carved with the names of farseers back to Draenor. There's room for a few more.

ds_spear_of_the_last_island.name: Spear of the Last Island
ds_spear_of_the_last_island.flavor_text: Made from driftwood off the last island the Darkspear held. They mean to take the rest back with it.

ds_kangaris_hexing_staff.name: Kang'ari's Spirit Staff
ds_kangaris_hexing_staff.flavor_text: Hung with the elder's own fetishes. It grumbles when it isn't used.

ds_senjin_throwing_axes.name: Sen'jin's Throwing Axes
ds_senjin_throwing_axes.flavor_text: A matched pair, balanced the old way. They come back to the hand if you know how to ask.

fs_banshees_lament.name: Banshee's Lament
fs_banshees_lament.flavor_text: A dark ranger's longbow. The string sighs when it's drawn.

fs_blade_of_the_wakened.name: Blade of the Wakened
fs_blade_of_the_wakened.flavor_text: Taken out of a Scourge armoury by the first of the dead to wake. It never went back.

fs_plaguebearers_staff.name: Plaguebearer's Staff
fs_plaguebearers_staff.flavor_text: Topped with a sealed vial from the Apothecarium. Don't drop it.

sc_profit_margin.name: Profit Margin
sc_profit_margin.flavor_text: A goblin's knife, thin and very sharp. It's the margin you don't see that does the damage.

sc_the_neutrality_clause.name: The Neutrality Clause
sc_the_neutrality_clause.flavor_text: A goblin tower shield with the Cartel's terms painted on the front. Breaking them is extra.

sc_arbiters_cloak.name: Cartel Arbiter's Cloak
sc_arbiters_cloak.flavor_text: Worn by the goblins who settle disputes on the quay. Nobody argues twice.

tb_spire_wardens_staff.name: Spire-Warden's Staff
tb_spire_wardens_staff.flavor_text: The staff of the druid who held the last spire's stair. A bear fights with it as well as a tauren.

tb_mulgore_greatbow.name: Mulgore Greatbow
tb_mulgore_greatbow.flavor_text: Strung for the plains as they were. The hunters who carry it mean to see them again.

tb_cloak_of_the_fallen_spires.name: Cloak of the Fallen Spires
tb_cloak_of_the_fallen_spires.flavor_text: Woven by the Elders' weavers, with four spires in the border and the ground beneath them missing.

bb_revilgaz_cutlass.name: Revilgaz's Cutlass
bb_revilgaz_cutlass.flavor_text: The Baron's spare. He has a lot of spares, and he's particular about who gets one.

bb_port_authority_blunderbuss.name: Port Authority Blunderbuss
bb_port_authority_blunderbuss.flavor_text: Licensed, stamped and loaded with whatever was cheap that week.

bb_cloak_of_the_deep_harbour.name: Cloak of the Deep Harbour
bb_cloak_of_the_deep_harbour.flavor_text: Sea-blue and heavy with salt. The only deep-water harbour left, on your shoulders.

ac_thanes_claim.name: Thane's Claim
ac_thanes_claim.flavor_text: A Dark Iron warhammer with the deed to Khaz Varun engraved down the haft.

ac_firebrand_scepter.name: Firebrand Scepter
ac_firebrand_scepter.flavor_text: Cast from scoria and Dark Iron. It's warm in the hand and hot at the head.

ac_khaz_varun_deedstone.name: Khaz Varun Deedstone
ac_khaz_varun_deedstone.flavor_text: A chip of Khaz Varun's gate on a chain. Whoever holds the gate holds the hall.

er_moonboughs_gift.name: Moonbough's Gift
er_moonboughs_gift.flavor_text: A ring of living wood, grown around a moonstone by the Arch Druid's own hand.

er_glaive_of_the_fel_line.name: Glaive of the Fel Line
er_glaive_of_the_fel_line.flavor_text: A Sentinel's war glaive. The Fel Line moves north a little every week, and this is why.

er_windcallers_bough.name: Windcaller's Bough
er_windcallers_bough.flavor_text: A bound book with covers of living wood. Leaves still grow out of the spine in spring.
